headline: Get Cornet
title: How to Get Cornet | The Wind Attacker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Cornet is a Wind attacker from the Chirpi line. The basic form is in The Argent Strait, where one spot is a small island and you open the shells there to spawn it. A Chirpi becomes Cornet at level eighteen with nothing extra. A Prismana Cornet shows up in the Strait during Aurora. Weak to Lightning and Light. Do you want Cornet? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Cornet is a Wind attacker found in The Argent Strait. A Chirpi evolves into it at level 18 with no extra requirement, and a Prismana form appears there during Aurora.
